newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler overseas sales rose 3 pct in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler overseas sales rose 3 pct in Feb.

text.p: Chrysler Corp said Wednesday it sold 17,731 vehicles overseas in February, a three percent improvement from a year ago.

The biggest percentage gains were made by the Jeep Wrangler, which rose 140 percent, and Jeep Grand Cherokee, where sales were up 56 percent. Both sport utility vehicles are now available in both right hand drive and left hand drive configurations.
On a regional basis, France was the best performer in Europe, rising 31 percent; Venezuela lead in Latin America, increasing 289 percent; and Australia had the best gains in Asia, up 175 percent.
